The main takeaway from our work is that
the development and calibration of severity scales for the three causal agents of the Avocado Wilt Complex (AWC) can be used as epidemiological and diagnostic tools for this disease.
the severity scale developed for avocado wilt complex (AWC) caused by Phytopthhora cinnamomi and Verticillium can be used in the diagnosis of the disease and in its management.
the severity scale of AWC caused by V. dahliae, P. cinnamomi and hypoxia-anoxia disorder can be used in epidemiological studies and for the diagnosis and management of AWC.
